name: Stormbringer: Shockingly Powerful triggers Conduction on a Torrential Wrath critical (#2162)
contract: Shockingly Powerful 572310 reads 'Critical strikes with Torrential Wrath now trigger Conductive. Increases the damage of Stormflow by $s2%.' Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), EffectBasePoints 49 + EffectDieSides 1 = 50 and EffectSpellClassMask 0x0/0x10000/0x0, which is Stormflow 567555 (SpellFamilyFlags1 0x10000, a SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE channel, amplitude 1000): that half is delivered by the native spell-modifier path and Player::ApplySpellMod makes percentage DAMAGE/DOT mods multiplicative, so a base of 1000 reads 1000 without the passive and 1000 * 1.5 = 1500 with it. Effect 0 is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) with TriggerSpell 567560 Conduction - the spell the DBC record names, where the tooltip says 'Conductive' - and EffectSpellClassMask 0/0/0. Spell.dbc gives 572310 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it ('Skip if no proc flags in DBC') and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0: no critical strike ever triggered Conduction, and the restriction to Torrential Wrath (SpellFamilyName 22, SpellFamilyMask1 0x1) and to criticals (HitMask 2 = PROC_HIT_CRITICAL at SpellPhaseMask 2 = PROC_SPELL_PHASE_HIT) has to come from the spell_proc row. The fixture's spell_crit_rating 100000 makes the critical deterministic instead of hoping for one, which the scenario checks with spell_done_crit_chance before relying on it. Torrential Wrath 804017 has CastingTimeIndex 19 = 2500 ms; it carries no AscensionCustomResourceData.h cost rule, but its own Spell.dbc CasterAuraSpell field is 573249 ("At Least 40 Static"), so Spell::CheckCast rejects it below 40 stacks of 803102 - the scenario seeds 100 stacks before the first cast to satisfy that native gate.
